meta.meta_title: High voltage Li-rich Mn-based cathode modified by silica-coated silver nanowires
meta.meta_authors: Huihui Gan , Liang Li , Pengyuan Qiu , Mingyu Cui , Jiajun Sun , Ye Xia , Wen Zhu

materials.name: Li1.20Mn0.54Ni0.13Co0.13O2
materials.description: Untreated Li-rich manganese oxide cathode material synthesized via solid-phase sintering.

materials.name: AgNWs-modified Li1.20Mn0.54Ni0.13Co0.13O2
materials.description: Ag nanowires modified LRMO (without SiO2 coating) as a control.

materials.name: AgNWs@SiO2 (thin coating) modified Li1.20Mn0.54Ni0.13Co0.13O2
materials.description: Ag nanowires with thin SiO2 coating layer (5-20 nm) incorporated into LRMO cathode.

materials.name: AgNWs@SiO2 (thick coating) modified Li1.20Mn0.54Ni0.13Co0.13O2
materials.description: Ag nanowires with thick SiO2 coating layer (30-50 nm) incorporated into LRMO cathode.
